column2: Where do I find older versions (text, site, photo, sound, montage, board)?
column3: The same “🕘 Versions” window everywhere: File → “🕘 Versions…” in the word processor, My website, Retouch, Sound studio and the montage; “🕘 Versions…” under the photo or sound in quick retouch and Quick sound; “📸 Snapshots” in a board. At the top, “All / ✎ Named / 🕘 Automatic”; the list is grouped by Today, This week, Older, with “Now” at the very top. Click a version to see it; tick two to compare them (text struck through / added, two sounds to listen to as A / B, two images with a line to drag). “↺ Go back to this version” asks nothing: what was there is kept first, and “↶ Undo” puts everything back. The ⋯ button of a version (or right-click): ✎ Rename, ⧉ Make a copy, ⤓ Export, 🗑 Delete (with “↶ Undo”). The original of a photo or sound is never deleted.

column2: How do I check a story against my records, count the words or listen to it?
column3: Tools → “🔎 Check against the records”: the dates and places written near a name from the database are compared with that person’s record (birth, marriage, death, ages, Sosa numbers); nothing is changed on its own. “🔢 Word count” (also at the bottom left); the document’s language is used for spelling (words underlined, corrections on right-click) and for “🔊 Read aloud”.

column2: How do I send a document into a book in the layout?
column3: File → “📐 Send to the layout…”: a new book, or the end of an existing book. Heading 1 paragraphs become chapters, bold and italic stay, images get their own page with their caption, notes go into a “Notes” part. The layout remains the tool for composing the book; the word processor the one for writing.

column2: How do I ask the family who is in a photo?
column3: Open the photo (viewer) and click “📤 Ask who it is” (also: Lists → Media → 👤 Faces → “📤 Ask the family” on unknown faces, or Lists → 💬 Questions for relatives → “🔍 Who is in this photo?” → “＋ New request…” for several photos). Click the frames to choose the faces (or draw one with the mouse; “🔍 Find faces” looks for them on its own), choose the names to suggest, then “⤓ Download the file”. Your cousin opens it at home, without the app or the Internet: they click a face, write a name or choose it from the list, add a note, then “Save my answers”. The file only contains the photos, frames and names you chose: never a confidential record, never a living person unless you tick the box.

column2: How do I import my cousins’ answers about a photo?
column3: Lists → 💬 Questions for relatives → “⤒ Import the answers” (the file “reponses-visages.json” sent back to you). For each face: the suggested name, who said it, the record to link (“Is it the same person?”, through the picker), and ✓ Accept / ✕ Refuse / Later. If several cousins answered, you see whether they agree (green “Agreement” chip) or not (red “Disagreement”). An accepted face becomes an identification on the photo; “↶ Undo” puts everything back as before.

column2: How do I write a letter to request a record?
column3: On a record: “⋯” → “📮 Request a record…”; also in “What’s missing?” (“📮 Request the record” button on a missing birth, marriage or death) and in Lists → Letter register (“📮 Request a record”, “Prepare the letter” for recent records). Choose the record and what you are asking for (full copy, extract with or without parentage, search in the archives, transcription of a record abroad, dispensation file): the letter writes itself, with the person, the dates, the parents, your relationship and the recipient’s address (town hall, departmental archives, Central civil registry in Nantes, diocesan archives), which you can correct. The time-limit rule is explained: in France a birth or marriage record is freely accessible after 75 years; before that, the full copy is reserved for direct family. Then: 📝 word processor, 🖨 Print or ⤓ PDF, ✉️ e-mail ready (nothing is sent by the app), 📁 copy in the media, and “📮 Store in tracked letters” (with the reminder date, also in “My research week”).

column2: Where do I set my address and my letter templates?
column3: In the “📮 Request the record” window, ⚙️ button at the top: your name, your address, your town, your e-mail, the reminder delay and the templates for each kind of letter (with placeholders like {personne}, {evenement}, {demande}). Everything is kept straight away; “💾 Saved settings” keeps several sets under a name.

column2: Where do I find “Write about this person” and research reports?
column3: On a person’s record, the 📝 button at the top opens a story already filled with their biography (also: 📖 Biography block → “Put in ▾” → word processor). In the Research log, “⋯” → “📝 Report” makes a document of the research shown; in archive visits, “📝 Report” on each mission sheet.

column2: How do I organise the family book?
column3: Settings → Clean export → Family book: tick the parts (cover, preface, figures, tree, records, chronology, places, index, closing word) and order them; the same for what each record shows. Choose the style, font, page size, then the format: PDF (through printing), HTML, Word, OpenDocument, ePub (e-reader), Markdown, text or CSV.

column2: What is the layout workshop (InDesign style)?
column3: Settings → Clean export → Family book → “Open the layout workshop”. It is a small InDesign for making the book of your genealogy: single pages or facing pages, masters (folio, running head), layers, text frames (computer font, size, leading, tracking, capitals, alignments, indents, drop cap, columns), shapes (rectangle, ellipse, polygon, star, line, pen), image frames, swatches and gradients, strokes, effects (opacity, blend, drop shadow, feather, rounded corners), text wrap, Pathfinder, align and distribute, links. You save, pick it up later, export.

column2: Where do I find the books made in the layout workshop?
column3: Lists → 📐 Family books: all the books and your designs, with their cover. Open, duplicate, rename, export, delete; at the top, “New book from the family”, “From a design”, “Blank page”, “Default settings” and the workshop.

column2: How do I start a book in the layout workshop?
column3: In the workshop: “＋ New book from the family” (a branch, the parts you want, a design: the cover, one page per person with their photo, the chronology, the index… texts that are too long continue on the next page), “🎨 New from a design”, or “📄 Blank page”. You choose the size, the margins (top, bottom, inside, outside), the columns and gutter, the bleed and the baseline grid. “⚙️ Default settings” sets what new documents get.

column2: What is a design in the layout workshop, and how do I make one?
column3: A design is a template: cover, masters, paragraph and character styles, colours. The app offers six (Classic, Modern, Elegant, Sepia, Photo album, Plain): “Use” or “Edit (as my own)”. Your own design: open a book, then File → “🎨 Save as design”. The list shows the cover of each book and each design.

column2: How do I add pages or go to a page in the layout workshop?
column3: Page menu (or 📄 Pages panel): “＋ Page at the end”, “＋ Insert…” (as many pages as you want, before or after a given page, at the start or end, with the chosen master), duplicate, delete, move a page forward or back. To go to a page: the “Page” box at the bottom, ⌘J, or Page Up / Page Down on the keyboard.

column2: What are the shortcuts of the layout workshop?
column3: V selection, T text, F image frame, M rectangle, L ellipse, Y polygon, E star, \ line, P pen (double-click or Enter to finish, click on the first point to close), H hand, Z zoom. ⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z undo and redo, ⌘C ⌘X ⌘V ⌘D, ⌘A, ⌫ delete, arrows to nudge (Shift: 5 mm), ⌘] ⌘[ bring forward and send backward, ⌘0 whole page, ⌘S save, W preview. Alt while dragging: a copy. Shift: proportions kept.

column2: How do I export the book from the layout workshop as a PDF?
column3: File → “⤓ Export as PDF (print)” opens the book ready to print: “Print”, then “Save as PDF”. For a printer: “PDF with bleed and crop marks”. Also: HTML page (photos included) and document file (.json) to keep or pass on to someone (“Import a document” in the workshop).

column2: How do I undo a change in the layout workshop?
column3: ↶ ↷ buttons at the top (or ⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z). The 🕘 History panel lists each change: a click on a step goes back to it, the following ones stay greyed out as long as you do nothing else.

column2: How do I widen the right panel of the layout workshop or of Retouch?
column3: Drag its left edge (the cursor becomes ↔) to the left to widen it, to the right to narrow it; the width is kept. Double-click the edge: starting size.

column2: How do I create or change a master in the layout workshop?
column3: 📄 Pages panel → Masters: “＋ New master” (you give it a name), “Edit” to place what comes back on its pages (folio, rules…), “→ p. N” to apply it to the current page, “Page without master”, or “Detach items” to change on this page only what comes from the master.

column2: How do I put the colour I want on a text or an object in the workshop?
column3: Text: choose the words, then 🅰 Text panel → Character → “Free colour” (the square opens all colours, or type a code like #7a2e2e; the circles are the swatch colours). Object: click the fill or stroke square at the bottom of the tools, the palette opens directly. ⇄ (or ⇧X) swaps fill and stroke, ⧄ (or /) empties them, X switches from one to the other.

column2: How do I make text flow around a photo (text wrap)?
column3: In the layout workshop: choose the photo, 🔧 Object panel → “Text wrap”: around the frame, around the shape (ellipse) or jump object, and the distance. Neighbouring text frames flow past it.

column2: How do I import my tree from another program?
column3: Settings → Import → “⤒ Import a tree…”: GEDCOM file (also from Ancestry, MyHeritage, Geneanet, FamilySearch), Gramps (.gramps or .gpkg), Hérédis (.hmw), GedZip or MacFamilyTree.

column2: How do I add a cousin’s tree to my database?
column3: Settings → Merge a tree: their GEDCOM is compared with yours, then you decide record by record.

column2: How do I make a family book as a PDF?
column3: Settings → Clean export → Family book: the whole database, or the ancestors and/or descendants of a person over the number of generations you want, with the tree generation by generation, the biographies, the photos and the chronology. “Open for printing” then “Print / save as PDF”.

column2: How do I export only one branch?
column3: Settings → Clean export: choose the starting person and the ancestors or descendants to export.
